I have farmed here in Mbeya for many years, and this 0.16 hectare plot is small but it feeds my family. I will buy about 15 kilograms of urea from the agro-dealer and spread it along with manure from my cattle, because I own this land and I want to keep it productive. I will plant improved maize seed this season since my neighbor used it last year and his cobs were bigger than mine. My wife and children will work this plot together, and we will not hire outsiders or use chemicals because the piece is small and the rains here are usually enough.
